## Summary

[Partial] Determine capacity needs and verify static weights while considering welded crossbars for higher limits. [t191]

## Parts

- Gobi Ranger Rack: Classic look with tall siderails; 600lb capacity potentially increases if two steel crossbars are used. [t191]

## Tips & gotchas

- Check if a rack offers welded-in crossbars for higher weight limits, or accept that two separate bars might double the strength. [t191]
- Consider side-mounting rooftop tents to rails rather than sitting them directly on the basket load area. [t191]
